messages:
Lucy: Kestrel sent an RFI this morning. Big enterprise, asking for a short POC (2 weeks), SLA detail, pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted, and KMS/HSM options. Can someone help pull together answers + a capability matrix?
Rahul: I can start a capability matrix. link: https://redwood.internal/docs/kestrel-capability-matrix (draft)
Lucy: thanks — also they asked if we can support customer-managed keys for embeddings and model inputs/outputs during POC.
Devin: Short answer: yes. For hosted we offer CMK via AWS KMS (customer-owned key) for data at rest and TLS for in-flight. For Private/on-prem we can integrate with HSM/KMS via PKCS#11 or an HSM appliance. Need to call out that HSM integration requires the private deployment package + a short ops runbook.
Maya: @Lucy @Devin i'll need the RFI questionnaire to confirm controls. Send the security sheet and I'll do the mapping to our SSP items.
Lucy: dropping the RFI PDF here: https://files.kestrel.com/rfi/kestrel-rfi-2026.pdf (uploaded by customer)
sec-bot: Automated note: security-questionnaire-template v2 created at https://redwood.internal/templates/sec-q-template-v2.xlsx
Rahul: Matrix draft updated with KMS/HSM row and SLA differences (SLA percentages, RTO, RPO). Quick highlights: Hosted: best for fast POC, lower setup, standard 99.9% availability; Dedicated: reserve capacity, 99.95% targeted with commit; Private: fully configurable SLA via contract.
Lucy: pricing question from them: for a 2-week Dedicated POC what's the rough MRC vs usage?
Rahul: Example snippet for the RFI response (feel free to copy):
```
Dedicated POC (2 weeks):
- Reserved short-term commit: 2-week reserved pool (min 4 A100-equivalent GPU-hours/day): $6,000 flat for the 2-week window
- Overages: billed per-GPU-hour at standard dedicated overage rates
Hosted POC (usage): standard per-token/embed rates + ephemeral model caching; estimated cost for 2-week trial: ~$1,200 - $3,500 depending on query load
Private/on-prem: one-time deployment fee + monthly platform license; contact sales for exact quoterange
```
Devin: note — if they require HSM-backed signing for audit, add ~$1,200 flat integration effort (one-time) for the POC ops run.
Maya: security commentary for RFI: we will provide SOC2-type controls mapping, key rotation policy (90 days default), audit log retention options (30/90/365 days), and optional tenant-level audit exports. Also note: customer data residency supported in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for hosted.
Lucy: who will own the RFI text? I can assemble but want technical sanity checks before sending today EOD.
Rahul: I can take capability matrix and pricing section, will ping infra/ops for numbers.
Devin: i'll add the KMS/HSM integration snippet + runbook excerpt.
Maya: i'll own the security questionnaire answers. pls assign to me in the tracker.
Lucy: tagging legal — @Jen (Legal) — any contract caveats for a short dedicated POC? we might need a temporary T&Cs addendum for reserved capacity.
Jen (Legal): short POC addendum is fine. i'll draft a 2-page addendum: liability cap align w/ SOC2 low-risk, term fixed to 2 weeks, cancellation allowed w/ 48h notice prior to start. will share draft by EOD.
Rahul: added a small compatibility table for model variants + quantization recommended for cost saving during POC. see matrix link.
Lucy: perfect. Deadline plan: final RFI package assembled by 16:00 PT today, send to Kestrel by 17:00. Rahul/Devin/Maya/Jen — please drop your sections in the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/sales/kestrel/rfi-poc-2026/
Devin: dropping runbook excerpt here:
```
Ops runbook (POC):
1) Provision dedicated pool (4 GPUs)
2) Configure CMK in AWS account and test encryption flows
3) Deploy model variant quantized int8 for latency testing
4) Smoke tests + perf run (10k tokens/day)
```
Maya: FYI — i'll call out that some enterprise customers require an in-country key manager; that would push them to Private or Dedicated in-region.
Lucy: copy. any blockers?
Rahul: none from product. one ask: can sales commit to the estimated budget lines in the email? if so i'll include numbers concretely.
Lucy: sales OK to include the example numbers Rahul gave, mark them as estimates. We'll add a note: final invoice will reflect measured usage and any integration fees.
sec-bot: Reminder: upload completed questionnaire to tracker to trigger security review workflow.
Lucy: great work. i'll assemble and send. :thumbsup:
